=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text yes " is a leap year\n"
text no " is not a leap year\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn leap y ulong to bool
if eq rem y 400 0
ret true
end
if eq rem y 100 0
ret false
end
ret eq rem y 4 0
end
fn show y ulong to void
emitu y
if leap y
emit yes
else
emit no
end
end
fn main to int
show 1900
show 1996
show 2000
show 2023
show 2024
show 2100
show 2400
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
1900 is not a leap year
1996 is a leap year
2000 is a leap year
2023 is not a leap year
2024 is a leap year
2100 is not a leap year
2400 is a leap year
</pre>
